name: SAP Academic System
description: testing halaman Simplified academic records system with students and course enrollments. Focused on grade analysis and academic performance.

tables.name: students
tables.description: Student profiles with faculty, major, GPA and scholarship status

tables.name: enrollments
tables.description: Course enrollment records with term, grade, and attendance percentage

relationships.description: Each enrollment record belongs to one student

sample_queries.title: GPA Distribution by Faculty
sample_queries.description: Average GPA breakdown across different faculties
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  faculty,
  COUNT(*) as student_count,
  ROUND(AVG(current_gpa), 2) as avg_gpa,
  MIN(current_gpa) as min_gpa,
  MAX(current_gpa) as max_gpa
FROM students
GROUP BY faculty
ORDER BY avg_gpa DESC;

sample_queries.title: Students with Low Attendance and High Grades
sample_queries.description: Identify students who score well despite low attendance
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  s.student_name,
  s.major,
  e.academic_term,
  e.attendance_pct,
  e.final_grade
FROM students s
JOIN enrollments e ON s.student_id = e.student_id
WHERE e.attendance_pct < 75 AND e.final_grade >= 80
ORDER BY e.final_grade DESC;

sample_queries.title: Term-over-Term Grade Comparison
sample_queries.description: Average grades per academic term to track trends
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  academic_term,
  COUNT(*) as enrollments,
  ROUND(AVG(final_grade), 2) as avg_grade,
  ROUND(AVG(attendance_pct), 1) as avg_attendance
FROM enrollments
GROUP BY academic_term
ORDER BY academic_term;
